title: Score
description: Computed accuracy for one forecast. Derived & replayable from the append-only forecast + decision logs, so it can always be regenerated.

status.description: 'in_progress' applies to path forecasts mid-horizon (the on-pace tracker).

direction_correct.description: Point: did they get raise/hold/cut right?

magnitude_error_bps.description: Point: abs error between predicted and actual bps move.

timing_correct.description: Point: did the move happen at the meeting they named?

on_pace.description: Path: are deliveries tracking toward the predicted total?

delivered_so_far.description: Path: net moves delivered within the horizon to date.

predicted_total.description: Path: net moves the forecaster predicted over the horizon.

score_version.description: Version of the scoring logic that produced this record.
